item.title: Sudan’s elderly face hardship and heartbreak in a life of displacement
item.description: Sudan's displaced elderly often have to support grandchildren or fend for themselves.

item.title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least four Palestinians
item.description: Israeli drone attack kills three people in Gaza City, another shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia.

item.title: Florida residents turn to kayaks and rafts as floods swamp streets
item.description: Days of heavy rain have flooded streets across Florida, forcing residents to find creative ways to get around.

item.title: Mexico captures FBI-wanted cartel boss in military raid
item.description: Mexico’s military captured FBI-wanted cartel leader ‘El Chapo Isidro’ in Guasave, Sinaloa.

item.title: Why is GTA VI so expensive to play?
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI costs less than GTA V to buy, yet far more to play. AJLabs explains where the money goes.

item.title: Pakistan drop Rizwan and Masood, but back Babar and Agha in overhaul
item.description: Former captains Mohammad Rizwan and Shan Masood lose Pakistan central contracts, but Babar Azam and Salman Agha backed.

item.title: Migrants caravan in Mexico walks towards US border
item.description: Around 300 migrants have crossed from Guatemala into Mexico, hoping to reach the United States.

item.title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
item.description: Warsaw accuses Moscow of intentional provocation, but bar for triggering NATO's collective defence clause remains high.

item.title: Deadly fire engulfs power station in southern Iraq
item.description: At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a fire tore through the Hartha power station complex.

item.title: Usman Khawaja and David Warner taken off air over Australia’s Sandpapergate
item.description: Ex-Australia cricketers Khawaja and Warner taken off air having been most outspoken over 2018 scandal in South Africa.

item.title: Demolition notices for buildings in Hebron provoke fear among Palestinians
item.description: Palestinians fear forced displacement as Israeli authorities target legally licensed homes in West Bank.

item.title: Cavaliers’ Harden passes Bryant, closes on Jordan in NBA 50-point game list
item.description: James Harden climbs NBA career record list in leading Cleveland Cavaliers to 128-119 win over Indiana Pacers.

item.title: Nations agree to ‘elaborate’ on rules for AI-run ‘killer robots’ by 2028
item.description: Members of the UN's Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons fail to agree on swift adoption of legally binding rules.

item.title: Verstappen escapes Vegas F1 discipline, takes pole as Antonelli penalised
item.description: Max Verstappen escapes discipline in Vegas F1 practice after run-ins and takes pole as Kimi Antonelli hit with penalty.

item.title: Sandpapergate: Cummins has Australia’s ‘unanimous support’ as Test captain
item.description: Pat Cummins to remain Test captain after Cricket Australia back cricketer following cheating scandal in South Africa.

item.title: Iran says it downed US drones over Hormuz as bid to end war remains stalled
item.description: Iran reiterates conditions for Hormuz reopening as US slaps sanctions on four Iranians it says acted as 'oil trustees'.

item.title: Fire sprinkler sprays water at flame-covered sign in China
item.description: An automatic sprinkler system repeatedly sprayed a barbecue sign depicting flames at China’s Wanlong Ski Resort.

item.title: French police officers guilty of Michel Zecler assault: What happens now?
item.description: Officers dealt more than 30 blows to the Black music producer in what the court ruled was a racially motivated crime.

item.title: Harry Kane to miss ‘a few months’ after injury as Bayern Munich draw
item.description: Ballon d'Or winner tears a ligament in his left ankle during Bayern Munich’s 1-1 draw against Cologne.

item.title: Illicit alcohol kills 11, poisons 180 in northeast India’s Manipur state
item.description: Manipur's chief minister orders a probe into the incident, saying those responsible will be arrested and punished.

item.title: Swimmer braves tanker attacks to expose Hormuz contamination
item.description: As tankers burned in Hormuz, swimmer Lewis Pugh exposed another casualty of the US-Israeli war on Iran: marine life.

item.title: Gianni Infantino’s FIFA re-election backed by South America’s CONMEBOL
item.description: Infantino handed huge boost in re-election campaign as FIFA president as CONMEBOL offers unanimous support.

item.title: Spain court grants bail to pro-Palestinian activist James ‘Fergie’ Chambers
item.description: Spain’s High Court granted conditional bail to James ‘Fergie’ Chambers, a pro-Palestinian philanthropist.

item.title: Can mediation succeed in a war-torn world? | Episode 1
item.description: With more than 65 armed conflicts raging worldwide, top mediators reveal why peace has never been harder to achieve.

item.title: At least four killed, 35 injured in fire at power station in Iraq’s Basra
item.description: The blaze erupted at the Hartha power station and spread to nearby houses.
